answer: To counter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can bind identities to phytosensing telemetry. A node authenticates by running an attestation kernel that tracks bio-electric voltage wander across the cambium of an instrumented willow trunk. An attacker must install discrete probe hardware on separate living trees per identity, incurring substantial site-access and physical deployment costs. However, winter dormancy suppresses sap circulation, occasionally triggering false rejections.
